name: BadgeAlt
intent: Alternate status or category label: tinted fill with a matching border, in three sizes.
usage: BadgeAlt is the alternate badge style: a light tint, a matching border and intent-colored text, with a brand intent. Use Badge by default; use BadgeAlt only where a screen already uses this style. Do not mix Badge and BadgeAlt on one screen. Only dismissible filters are removable. See contracts/badgealt.json for the full contract.

removable.note: Adds an X button that calls onRemove.

disabled.note: Dims the badge. The X does not fire.

onRemove.note: Called by the X when removable.

useWhen: A screen that already uses the tinted, bordered badge style.
A brand marker, like Beta, in that style.
doNot: Do not use BadgeAlt where Badge fits. Badge is the default.
Do not mix Badge and BadgeAlt on one screen.
Do not use as a button or link. Only the X is interactive.
Do not use for people. Use Avatar.
Do not put sentences in a badge.
a11y: Text is the content; intent color is never the only signal.
Text uses the -strong intent colors so every intent reads at 4.5:1 or more, light and dark.
The X is a native button labeled Remove {children}, with a focus ring. When disabled, it is disabled too.

examples.title: Brand
examples.usage: Product or feature markers, like Beta. Not a status.

examples.title: Success
examples.usage: Active, complete or healthy states on rows and cards.

examples.title: Warning
examples.usage: Pending or needs-attention states the user can still fix.

examples.title: Danger
examples.usage: Blocked, failed or overdue status. Not a delete button.

examples.title: Info
examples.usage: In-progress or informational status that is neither success nor a problem.

examples.title: Removable
examples.usage: Only for dismissible filters. The X is the only interactive part.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.usage: Dims the badge. If it is removable, the X does not fire.
